description: This Java source file defines the LoanAccrualEventService class, which is responsible for listening to loan-related business events (such as loan closure and balance change) and triggering accrual processing accordingly within the Fineract platform.

classes.name: LoanAccrualEventService
classes.description: Service for listening to loan-related events and triggering accrual processing.

classes.name: LoanCloseListener
classes.description: Listener for handling loan closure events, triggers accrual processing when a loan is closed.

classes.name: LoanBalanceChangedListener
classes.description: Listener for handling loan balance change events, triggers accrual processing on balance change.

methods.name: addListeners
methods.description: Initializes event listeners for loan close and balance changed events after bean creation.

methods.name: onBusinessEvent (LoanCloseBusinessEvent)
methods.description: Handles loan close events, initiates accrual processing if the loan is closed or overpaid.

methods.name: onBusinessEvent (LoanBalanceChangedBusinessEvent)
methods.description: Handles loan balance change events, initiates accrual processing if the loan is closed or overpaid.
